info.title: Safrod API
info.description:
Self-hostable Bitcoin and Lightning payment infrastructure. Runs on regtest only; not audited; do not use with real funds.

`/v1/lightning` and `/v1/bitcoin` are backed by real regtest nodes. `/v1/sandbox` is simulated and every response is labelled `simulated_fiat: true`. This is an original API; it makes no compatibility claim with any third-party API.
